_note: Hand-placed terrain features on the 641 x 641 grid (r = row from north, c = column from west). Crevasses, pits and small seracs on the glaciers are generated from the terrain (see sim/terrainFeatures.js); these are the named ones. Positions follow the real route as closely as the 31 m elevation model allows, and the cols are the saddles in the elevation data nearest their published heights.
_wand_trail: Expeditions mark a safe line across the Godwin-Austen Glacier from Base Camp to the foot of the Abruzzi Spur with bamboo wands. Crevasses are kept clear of it; leave it and you are on your own.

wand_trail.name: Wanded trail to Advanced Base Camp

_bergschrund: The big crevasse where the glacier pulls away from the foot of the Abruzzi Spur. Bridged where the wanded trail crosses it.
_seracs: Hanging ice cliffs. The Bottleneck serac hangs over the couloir and the Traverse at about 8,400 m; climbers pass beneath it for an hour or more. Its blocks break off at any hour.
_couloirs: Gullies cut into the face by the fine terrain (fineTerrain.js): a rounded snow floor width_m across and depth_m deep, with ragged rock walls up to walls_m high either side, narrowing at its neck. The Bottleneck is the couloir the route climbs to the Traverse.
_cornices: Wind-built snow lips overhanging the lee side of ridge crests, on whichever side of the crest drops away (the lee hint picks the side when both do; the prevailing wind is westerly). 'overhang' is the same thing on the edge of a rock step. Walk out onto one and it can break off under you.

cornices.name: Snow overhang above the Black Pyramid

_caverns: Snow caves and ice caverns: out of the wind. Resting in one heals nearly as well as a camp.
_zones: Technical sections. speed multiplies your pace, slip your chance of slipping unroped.

zones.name: House's Chimney
zones.note: a 30 m crack of steep rock, the crux below Camp 2

zones.name: Black Pyramid
zones.note: steep, broken rock and ice from Camp 2 to Camp 3

zones.name: The Bottleneck
zones.note: a steep ice couloir under the serac

zones.name: The Traverse
zones.note: steep ice under the serac, exposed all the way

_cols: Saddles between peaks. The wind funnels through them.

cols.name: Negrotto Col
cols.note: at the foot of K2's West Ridge

cols.name: Windy Gap
cols.note: between K2's northeast side and Skyang Kangri
